name: expression-origin
description: One entity whose update and delete conditions refuse values the request may not have sent: only a refusal of a field the body carried is the caller's 422 expression-failed; the stored row, a literal, @user and a delete are 500 function-failed on every engine (HX-10 Ruling 44).

parcels.description: A parcel whose weight arrives as text; nothing checks it on create, so a stored weight can be no number.

action.reject: A parcel weighs at most 9999 g.
